ops.body:
Orchestrator-adjudicated during the P7 docs pass (cc-task 0bb5d04b): the curated great-docs reference gains `Occurrence` (Command lines section, so the 13.2.0 splice surface renders beside Command/CommandLine) and drops the dead `cli:` block (module `cc_transcript.cli` deleted in P5). Deliberately NOT curated for v14 — private surface: `SpecMatcher`, `keep_events`, `label_events`, `embedded_literals`. Revisit if any of the four graduates to the public API.

AMENDED (orchestrator ruling after the P7 gate run): `Fidelity` was first added per the original adjudication, then DROPPED — it is a PEP 695 `type` alias (`type Fidelity = Literal["full", "summary"]`, context.py), and the great-docs reference renders through static griffe (see the "v14 docs rendering" note 4e18bcca — dynamic mode is permanently off for this package), which fails the whole build with "Cannot document object of kind: Kind.TYPE_ALIAS". Confirmed by an A/B build: red with the line, green with only that line removed. Fidelity stays documented via context.py docstrings and guide prose, not as a reference page. Same constraint applies to any future curated candidate that is a `type` statement alias (`Role`, `Preview`, …).

Related finding, reported not fixed (docs lane had a no-code-edits mandate): `scripts/gen_command_golden.py`'s module docstring still narrates the pre-flip world ("Freeze the Python CommandLine structure", "tests/test_command_parity.py asserts the Rust port reproduces") — post-P6 the script would freeze native output, and the Python reference it names is deleted.
